Thanks again for the time today — really appreciate the thoughtful discussion on your retrieval + summarization use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC kicked off smoothly:

  3) Two optimization passes (batching/quantization) and QA
  4) Wrap with results review and next steps

- Share a temporary S3 bucket or sample dataset and the person to grant access to.
- Confirm a 60-90 minute kickoff slot next week (suggested: Tue 24 Aug or Wed 25 Aug morning).
